newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index up at noon on good interims.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index up at noon on good interims.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares rose 2.8 percent in Monday morning trade with the mood helped by a positive showing from the first B share firm to announce its 1997 interim results, brokers said.

Shanghai Haixin Co, which makes plush material for children's toys and other products, said on Monday its net profit rose 75 percent in the first half to 45.876 million yuan based on domestic accounting standards.
The B share index rose 2.104 points or 2.77 percent to 77.955 points on volume of 3.651 million shares worth $2.277 million.
Brokers said sentiment appeared to have finally turned for the better following healthy rises for both the B share and the domestic currency A share markets late last week.
"Haixin had quite a credible performance," said an analyst at a European securities firm in Shanghai. "It was expected but it should help sentiment."
Haixin was suspended from trading in the morning on Monday for the results announcement and would resume trading in the afternoon.
Brokers said the coming crop of B share results to be announced later this month and in August may not look as good.

"Haixin did pretty well, but the better companies typically report their results first with the poor companies waiting until the deadline," said an analyst at Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co in Shanghai. "We have to wait and see."
Of 45 B shares, 39 traded with 24 up, 11 flat and 4 down.
Shanghai Steel Tube Co 900926.SS was the sharpest B share gainer on Monday morning, rising $0.010 or 8.33 percent to $0.130 on bargain hunting.
Hainan Airline Co was the most actively traded stock with volume of 891,000 shares. The recently listed airline rose $0.004 or 0.77 percent to $0.522 on domestic buying.
A shares continued to rise on Monday morning, adding to gains from Friday, brokers said.
The A share index rose 18.771 points or 1.56 percent to 1,225.628 points on volume of 276.364 million shares worth 3.39 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 75.324 points or 1.99 percent to to 3,869.628 points.
Brokers said A and B shares could see further gains on Monday afternoon but any rises would be limited by the absence from the market of major players.
